summary: Agnes Pruitt swapped Frank's Secret Santa brandy for nut-free truffles with one marzipan truffle at the front, took Gideon's adrenaline pen from his jacket, and urged him to eat. Her sister Eleanor carved the Marlowe Nutcracker, and Gideon's hush money was ending.
key_proof: The gift was swapped after 8:40: Frank's brandy in the bin (C14), Roz's photo of a lumpy gift (C16), the perfect bow and green tape (C01)
The marzipan truffle was bought at 4:45 on staff card 0012, Agnes's (C07, C08, C42, C43)
Agnes's 9:15 excuse fails: the Santa sack was under the tree from 9:00 (C33)
The pen in the ornament box (C41), the box Agnes padlocks (C32)
Victor heard her say "I checked the box myself"
The missing silver truffle in her locker (C44)
Motive: "Eleanor and little Agnes Finch" (C37) and the ledger of envelopes (C38, B8)
reveal: Santa's gift didn't kill Gideon Marlowe. Frank wrapped a bottle of brandy, badly, with clear tape and no bow. At ten to nine, the kindest woman in the store carried it off to the wrap table in the entrance hall "to fix the torn paper". She poured the brandy into the bin, put in a box of nut-free truffles she'd bought at a quarter to five on her own staff card, and moved one gold marzipan truffle to the front. She tied the bow she had taught everyone to tie, with tape from her own department, and put Santa's tag back on. At ten past nine she straightened Gideon's jacket and took his pen. At half past she called "Boss first!", and when he hesitated she told him, "They're nut-free, Gideon. I checked the box myself." In 1979 her big sister Eleanor carved the Marlowe Nutcracker and sold it for fifty pounds. For thirty-nine years Gideon paid Agnes to forget. Today he told her the money was ending, and that her sister's daughter was next. Agnes Pruitt, born Agnes Finch, you're under arrest.

timeline.text: Gideon tells Agnes the hush money ends and Roz will be fired.
Agnes buys nut-free truffles and one marzipan truffle on staff card 0012.
Agnes swaps Frank's brandy for the truffles and rewraps the gift.
Agnes takes the pen from Gideon's jacket.
She hides it in the ornament box.
"They're nut-free, Gideon, I checked the box myself." He eats the marzipan truffle.
